tasks.DefineVariables: Define variables for the train fare per person (x) and bus fare for two persons (y).
tasks.SetUpEquation1: Formulate an equation based on the given information that relates y to x.
tasks.SetUpEquation2: Formulate a second equation using the total fare paid by 6 persons travelling by bus and 8 persons travelling by train.
tasks.SolveForX: Solve for the value of x (train fare per person) from the equations.
